Message from Flo 🩸:
Our return and refund terms vary by product and purchase type: 
First-time leakproof underwear purchase: Your first pair is risk-free for 30 days. You may wear and wash it, then request a refund of the item price, excluding original shipping, or a free exchange for another size or style. If you purchase multiple pairs, only one pair should be opened, washed, and worn before starting an exchange. Used underwear cannot otherwise be returned for hygiene reasons.
Regular-price bras: Eligible for a refund or exchange within 30 days of delivery. Knix and Simone Pérèle bras are covered by the wash-and-wear policy. Nood bras and bra accessories must be brand new in their original packaging.
